# Solos Gems

> Solos Gems is a D&D-flavored AI tools database: the Herald's Hub at https://solosgems.com/ lists 250 AI tools across every major category, each with a plain-English summary, a retro video game style comic and caption, and a direct link to the real product. Every tool carries a score and a rank on one cross-category list (0-10, the average of value for price, real-world capability, ease of use, and trial safety), shown in its database row with a short note on why it landed there. 51 tools were tested hands-on; the rest are scouted from public pricing and features, and are labeled that way. Nothing scores a 10. Some links are affiliate links (disclosed on the About page); that never changes which tools are covered or what the verdict says. Standalone review pages (/reviews/...) were retired in September 2026 and now redirect to the matching database row.

Last updated: 2026-10-25.

## Ranked tools (#1-250, every tool in the database, each links to its row)

Tested = tested hands-on by Solos Gems. Scouted = scored from public pricing, docs, and features.

- [ChatGPT](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-chatgpt): #1, 9.25/10, Scouted. The realm's most popular familiar for a reason: a strong free tier, does nearly everything, and anyone can use it on day one.
- [Gemini](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-gemini): #2, 9/10, Scouted. Free, capable, and already living inside your Gmail and Docs. The home-field advantage is real.
- [Gemini Notebook](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-notebooklm): #3, 8.88/10, Tested. Free, grounded in your own sources, and hard to make hallucinate. The best-value scholar in the entire realm.
- [Claude](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-claude): #4, 8.88/10, Scouted. A careful, well-read scholar with a strong free tier. Loses a hair to ChatGPT only on sheer breadth of extra gadgets.
- [DeepSeek](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-deepseek): #5, 8.88/10, Scouted. Top-tier brains for free, with open weights for anyone who wants to run the spell at home. Hard to beat on value.
- [Canva Magic Studio](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-canva-magic-studio): #6, 8.75/10, Tested. Rolled high on value, ease, and a free tier generous enough to feel like a trap. It isn't. The fanciest spells just live behind Pro.
- [Fireflies.ai](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-fireflies-ai): #7, 8.75/10, Tested. Unlimited transcription on every tier, free included, is the kind of loot drop that makes the rest of the meeting-notes guild look stingy.
- [CapCut](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-capcut): #8, 8.75/10, Scouted. A free, powerful editor with AI tricks built for short-form video. Hard to beat for social creators.
- [Fathom](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-fathom): #9, 8.75/10, Scouted. A free meeting recorder with good summaries and no fuss. One of the best free spells in the realm.
- [DeepL](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-deepl): #10, 8.62/10, Scouted. The translator many call the most accurate in the realm, with a strong free tier. A polyglot familiar.
- [GitHub Copilot](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-github-copilot): #11, 8.62/10, Scouted. The default coding familiar, with a free tier and editor integration everywhere. Hard to go wrong.
- [Cal.com](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-cal-com): #12, 8.62/10, Scouted. An open-source Calendly rival with a generous free plan and an AI phone agent. Better value than the original.
- [Google Stitch](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-google-stitch): #13, 8.62/10, Scouted. Free multi-screen UI designs that paste straight into Figma. Hard to argue with free and good.
- [OpenAI Codex](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-openai-codex): #14, 8.5/10, Scouted. A strong coding agent bundled into ChatGPT plans, free included. Excellent value if you already pay for ChatGPT.
- [Google Antigravity](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-google-antigravity): #15, 8.5/10, Scouted. Free for individuals and runs a whole party of coding agents. Powerful, still new, and a little overwhelming.
- [Kling AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-kling-ai): #16, 8.5/10, Scouted. Realistic motion and a generous free tier. One of the best values in AI video right now.
- [Dreamina](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-dreamina): #17, 8.5/10, Scouted. Free daily credits, strong video and image models, and cheap upgrades. One of the best deals in AI video.
- [Kimi](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-kimi): #18, 8.5/10, Scouted. Free, reads a whole library in one sitting, and handles agentic tasks well. A strong assistant most of the realm hasn't met yet.
- [Linear](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-linear): #19, 8.5/10, Scouted. A fast, beautiful issue tracker, free for small teams. Makes project management feel almost pleasant.
- [Qwen Chat](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-qwen-chat): #20, 8.5/10, Scouted. Free to use and backed by open-weight models anyone can run. Strong value, a little less polish than the household names.
- [Raycast](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-raycast): #21, 8.5/10, Scouted. A free launcher that makes your whole computer faster, with AI on Pro. Beloved for good reason.
- [Meta AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-meta-ai): #22, 8.5/10, Scouted. Free and already in your group chats. Convenient as a tavern bard, not the deepest thinker in the room.
- [Hailuo AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-hailuo-ai): #23, 8.38/10, Scouted. Strong video from a photo or prompt with free credits to burn. A rising star of the video guild.
- [MagicSchool AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-magicschool-ai): #24, 8.38/10, Scouted. A free toolkit that saves teachers hours on lesson plans and rubrics. A paladin for the classroom.
- [Napkin AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-napkin-ai): #25, 8.38/10, Scouted. Free weekly credits and turns walls of text into clean diagrams in seconds. A narrow trick, performed beautifully.
- [Buffer](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-buffer): #26, 8.38/10, Scouted. Social scheduling with a genuinely usable free tier. The easiest way to post everywhere without losing your mind.
- [Khanmigo](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-khanmigo): #27, 8.38/10, Scouted. A free, patient tutor for teachers and cheap for families that refuses to just hand over answers. Wholesome and effective.
- [Granola](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-granola): #28, 8.25/10, Tested. The notetaker with no bot at the table. Easy, clever, and loved by everyone who tries it.
- [Beehiiv](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-beehiiv): #29, 8.25/10, Tested. Zero commission on paid subscriptions from day one. The newsletter guild's only innkeeper who doesn't skim off the top of your tips.
- [Grammarly](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-grammarly): #30, 8.25/10, Tested. So easy you forget it's casting. The free tier alone saves more embarrassing emails than most paid tools.
- [Consensus](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-consensus): #31, 8.25/10, Scouted. Answers backed by peer-reviewed papers, with a free tier. A scholar who cites real sources.
- [Microsoft Copilot](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-microsoft-copilot): #32, 8.25/10, Scouted. Free, useful, and woven through Windows and Office. The deep Office magic costs extra gold.
- [Superwhisper](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-superwhisper): #33, 8.25/10, Scouted. Private, on-device dictation for Mac and iOS, free to start. A quiet, loyal scribe.
- [Zed](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-zed): #34, 8.25/10, Scouted. A blazing-fast free editor with optional AI. Lean and lovely, with fewer AI tricks than the heavyweights.
- [Photoroom](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-photoroom): #35, 8.12/10, Tested. Background removal so quick and cheap it feels like a cantrip. The top product-photo tool for small sellers.
- [Wispr Flow](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-wispr-flow): #36, 8.12/10, Tested. Talk and it types, cleanly, in any app. Easy, generous free use, and genuinely faster than your fingers.
- [Hugging Face](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-hugging-face): #37, 8.12/10, Scouted. The great open library of models, mostly free. Indispensable for builders, bewildering for everyone else.
- [Ideogram](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-ideogram): #38, 8.12/10, Scouted. The rare image wizard that can actually spell. A free tier and readable text make it a designer's friend.
- [Perplexity Comet](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-perplexity-comet): #39, 8.12/10, Scouted. A free AI browser that reads and acts on the page you're on. Strong agent tricks, still settling in.
- [Dia](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-dia): #40, 8.12/10, Scouted. A free AI browser that actually understands your tabs. Promising, young, and still earning its reputation.
- [Julius](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-julius): #41, 8.12/10, Scouted. Chat with your spreadsheet and it builds the charts. A free plan and a gentle learning curve make it a top analyst.
- [Mistral Vibe](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-mistral-vibe): #42, 8.12/10, Scouted. A solid free assistant now doubling as a coding agent. A strong choice if you'd rather not hand your scrolls to the usual giants.
- [QuillBot](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-quillbot): #43, 8.12/10, Scouted. Paraphrasing, grammar, and a free AI detector in one cheap pouch. Not glamorous, very useful.
- [Otter.ai](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-otter-ai): #44, 8/10, Tested. A reliable court scribe with fast notes, docked a few points because the Business tier sells seats in packs of five like a wizard bulk-buying candles.
- [Reclaim.ai](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-reclaim-ai): #45, 8/10, Tested. Defends your focus time like a loyal shield-bearer, with a free tier that actually covers a solo calendar.
- [Flux](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-flux): #46, 8/10, Scouted. Gorgeous photorealism with open-weight versions you can run yourself. Top-tier art, a bit fiddly to wield.
- [Cline](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-cline): #47, 8/10, Scouted. Free, open source, and no vendor lock-in. Model costs are on you, and it assumes you're comfortable reading code.
- [Devin Desktop](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-windsurf): #48, 8/10, Scouted. A capable agentic code editor with a free tier. A real rival to Cursor, with a bumpier ownership history.
- [Udio](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-udio): #49, 8/10, Scouted. Coherent songs with separable tracks and a free tier. A serious rival to Suno.
- [Auphonic](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-auphonic): #50, 8/10, Scouted. Levels and cleans podcast audio automatically, with free monthly hours. Quietly essential.
- [Character.AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-character-ai): #51, 8/10, Scouted. Free and endlessly entertaining for roleplay and storytelling. Not built for real work, and safety concerns have reshaped it.
- [Raphael AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-raphael-ai): #52, 8/10, Scouted. Wander in with no account and draw all night, though the watermark and the queue are the toll at the gate.
- [tl;dv](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-tldv): #53, 7.88/10, Tested. Unlimited free recording and transcription. The only real cap is on AI summaries, which is a fair trade.
- [Veo](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-veo): #54, 7.88/10, Scouted. Google's top-tier video with sound, built into Gemini. Best results need a paid plan.
- [Cartesia](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-cartesia): #55, 7.88/10, Scouted. Ultra-fast voice AI with a free plan and a $5 Pro tier. A builder's delight, a little technical for others.
- [Elicit](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-elicit): #56, 7.88/10, Scouted. Automates literature reviews and evidence extraction, free to start. Superb for researchers.
- [n8n](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-n8n): #57, 7.88/10, Scouted. Open source and self-hostable, so the gold cost can hit zero. The price is your time learning the spellbook.
- [Krea AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-krea-ai): #58, 7.88/10, Scouted. Images that update live as you sketch, plus a free tier. Delightful to play with, genuinely useful too.
- [Moises](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-moises): #59, 7.88/10, Scouted. Stem separation good enough for working musicians, with a usable free tier. A practice-room essential.
- [Stable Diffusion](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-stable-diffusion): #60, 7.88/10, Scouted. Free and open to run on your own machine forever. Unbeatable value, if you can survive the setup dungeon.
- [Warp](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-warp): #61, 7.88/10, Scouted. A fast terminal with a capable agent mode and a free tier. Makes the command line feel less like a dungeon.
- [Amazon Q Developer](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-amazon-q-developer): #62, 7.88/10, Scouted. Free for individuals and great at AWS plumbing. Less exciting outside the AWS kingdom.
- [Willow Voice](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-willow-voice): #63, 7.88/10, Scouted. Cross-platform dictation that learns how you write, with a free tier. A friendly rival to Wispr Flow.
- [Rows](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-rows): #64, 7.88/10, Scouted. A spreadsheet with AI and live data built in, plus a real free plan. Quietly excellent.
- [Dyad](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-dyad): #65, 7.88/10, Scouted. A free, local-first forge with no guild paperwork. You supply the mana (API keys), so the clever hosted extras live in Pro.
- [Shopify Magic](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-shopify-magic): #66, 7.88/10, Scouted. Free AI inside Shopify for descriptions and images. Only useful if you already live in Shopify's castle.
- [Rytr](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-rytr): #67, 7.88/10, Scouted. A cheap, cheerful copywriter with a free plan. Not deep, very affordable.
- [Descript](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-descript): #68, 7.75/10, Tested. Editing video by editing text is a legendary spell. The learning curve and price keep it from the top of the tower.
- [Airtable](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-airtable): #69, 7.75/10, Tested. A spreadsheet that learned necromancy. Powerful, with a generous free plan, but it takes a few sessions to master.
- [Attio](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-attio): #70, 7.75/10, Tested. A modern CRM with AI on every plan, free included. A strong pick for small parties tracking many quests.
- [Toggl Track](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-toggl-track): #71, 7.75/10, Tested. Free for small parties and dead simple to use. The AI is a garnish, not the main course.
- [Luma Dream Machine](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-luma-dream-machine): #72, 7.75/10, Scouted. Video with real depth and camera movement, free to try. Strong, credit-limited.
- [Adobe Firefly](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-adobe-firefly): #73, 7.75/10, Scouted. Commercially safer images inside the Adobe tools you may already rent. Great if you live in Adobe's castle.
- [Leonardo AI](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-leonardo-ai): #74, 7.75/10, Scouted. Strong for game art and stylized illustration, with free daily credits. A favorite of the concept-art guild.
- [Recraft](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-recraft): #75, 7.75/10, Scouted. Brand-consistent graphics, icons, and vectors. The image tool that thinks like a designer.
- [Replit](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-replit): #76, 7.75/10, Scouted. Describe an app and Replit Agent builds and hosts it. Easy start, usage costs climb as the app grows.
- [CodeRabbit](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-coderabbit): #77, 7.75/10, Scouted. Reviews every pull request line by line, free for open source. A tireless second pair of eyes.
- [Magnific](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-freepik-ai): #78, 7.75/10, Scouted. Image generation stapled to a huge stock library with a free tier. A practical one-stop art shop.

- [Calendly](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-calendly): #103, 7.38/10, Tested. The easiest spell in the book: share a link, let the meeting cast itself. Not much magic beyond that, and it doesn't pretend otherwise.
- [Durable](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-durable): #104, 7.38/10, Tested. A website, CRM, and booking calendar in one quick spell. Not deep, but very fast to stand up.

- [LangChain](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-langchain): #110, 7.38/10, Scouted. Free, open-source plumbing for AI apps. Mighty if you code, a maze of pipes if you don't.

- [You.com](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-you-com): #117, 7.38/10, Scouted. Lets you pick which model answers. Flexible, but outshone by the bigger search familiars.

- [GPTZero](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-gptzero): #119, 7.38/10, Scouted. Easy and free to start, beloved by teachers. Like every AI detector, it can accuse an innocent scroll.

- [Grok](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-grok): #125, 7.25/10, Scouted. Sharp and plugged into X's live firehose, but the best features sit behind paid tiers and its chaotic alignment is a feature, apparently.
- [Higgsfield](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-higgsfield): #126, 7.25/10, Scouted. Cinematic camera moves on demand. Gorgeous presets, credit-hungry.
- [Kagi](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-kagi): #127, 7.25/10, Scouted. Ad-free search you pay for, which is refreshing and also, well, paying for search. Worth it for the devoted.
- [Genspark](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-genspark): #128, 7.25/10, Scouted. A Super Agent that researches and builds decks for you. Impressive when it works, credit-hungry when it doesn't.

- [Async](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-async): #130, 7.25/10, Scouted. Recording, editing, and AI cleanup in the browser with a free tier. A whole studio in one tab.
- [Ocoya](https://solosgems.com/database#tool-ocoya): #131, 7.25/10, Scouted. AI captions and scheduling across 30+ platforms with a free tier. Broad reach, lighter polish.

## Other pages

- [Herald's Hub / AI tools database](https://solosgems.com/): All 250 tools in a filterable, searchable database with a rank, score, and Tested or Scouted label on every tool, a live headline ticker, the Herald's Report (the latest AI headlines with D&D summaries, the top Realms by country, and three rotating DeathStack graves), and a Crystal Ball of trending AI projects from GitHub. Raw data: https://solosgems.com/data/tools.json and https://solosgems.com/data/tools.csv.
- [Realms](https://solosgems.com/realms.html): A live, D&D-styled world map of real AI activity by country: news coverage or verified company headquarters, search interest from Wikipedia pageviews, and build activity from GitHub.
- [About / methodology](https://solosgems.com/about.html): What the site is, how the ranking/scoring works, and the affiliate disclosure.
- [State of AI Tools for Solopreneurs 2026](https://solosgems.com/state-of-ai-tools.html): Original aggregate data pulled from the 51 scored reviews, median score, free-tier rate, category breadth, updated as new reviews are added.
- [DeathStack](https://solosgems.com/deathstack.html): 35 real, sourced case studies of AI tools and services that shut down (ChatGPT Plugins, Neeva, Olive AI, Builder.ai, Tune AI, Woebot, Coqui AI, Yara AI, Ghost Autonomy, Forward Health, Humane AI Pin, Tome, Sora, ChatGPT Atlas, Yupp, theGist, Reforged Labs, Relay.app, Astra, Doppl, Cruise, IBM Watson Health, Amazon Halo, Meta Galactica, Huxe, Icon, DALL-E, Limitless, Kite, Argo AI, Microsoft Tay, Artifact, Play.ht, and the PDF-chat wrapper category), with cause of death and the lesson for solopreneurs relying on a single AI vendor.
- [News](https://solosgems.com/news.html): Live AI industry headlines pulled automatically from TechCrunch, VentureBeat, MIT Technology Review, Wired, and Hacker News, refreshed on a schedule. Flagged for controversy/high discussion volume and for mentions of tools in this database.
- [Submit](https://solosgems.com/submit.html): Add an AI tool to the database, send a correction for an out-of-date listing, or report a defunct AI tool or service for the DeathStack graveyard.
- [Herald](https://solosgems.com/): A free general-purpose AI assistant on the homepage, in the Solos Gems voice. Ask any question (cooking, science, money, code, writing) and get a real answer told by a wry fantasy narrator. Built with Llama (Meta Llama 3.1 8B on Cloudflare Workers AI).
- [The Road to Solos Gems](https://solosgems.com/game.html): A choose-your-own-adventure storygame with a small real ability system. Build a character across eight AI-flavored abilities, then watch your build change which story you get. The goal: reach Solos Gems. Reachable from the Quest badge next to the logo in the site header.
